name: Legged Robots
description:
1.	Introduction to legged robots
2.	Modeling and control of a one leg robot that hops in the plane
3.	Modeling and control of a leg robot that hops in three dimensions.
4.	Control of biped and quadruped running
5.	Advanced control algorithms for controlling legged robots, including model predictive control and whole body control
prerequisites: Knowledge about robotics, have attended a robotic lecture, such as IN2067 (Robotics), IN2138 (Robot Motion Planning)
